text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need a final pass on the SEO prelaunch for the webinar + launch post. items: keyword list, schema markup for the webinar page, internal linking plan from the blog hub, and a redirect map for old URLs. can we confirm owners?
Samir Khan: I can own keywords + on-page meta. will push a cleaned spreadsheet w/ search intent buckets by EOD. also have a short list of target longtails for the webinar landing. @Jordan please review for voice.
Jordan Lee: thanks — I’ll fold those into the launch post draft. ask: do we prefer the webinar H1 to include the brand or the primary keyword? leaning keyword-first for SERP.
Maya Patel: keyword-first makes sense for organic. use brand in OG/title if possible. Jordan, keep the intro short and link to the benchmark narrative mid-article.
Priya Rao: inbound routing note — when we publish the webinar page, marketing webhook needs the final utm params and form slug so lead routing sends to the right SDR pool. current form is /forms/webinar-v2; confirm if we change.
Leo Chen: I’ll handle redirects. pls post the exact old->new paths. if we need a temporary 302 for tracking then swap to 301 after 7 days. example redirect we use: ```/old-webinar => /webinar/2026-launch``` — if you confirm, I’ll open PR against nginx conf.
Samir Khan: uploaded keywords: https://go.redwood/seo/179812-keywords (sheet). top clusters: "inference performance benchmarks", "low-latency LLM serving", "inference cost optimization". suggested primary for webinar: "inference cost benchmark webinar".
Jordan Lee: drafted intro + 3 CTAs. pushing doc: https://go.redwood/content/launch-webinar-draft. left TODOs for OG image and structured data example.
Maya Patel: structured data — Samir/Jordan can we include Event schema + FAQ schema? That should help rich results for the webinar and capture Qs from the benchmark narrative.
Samir Khan: yes. I'll generate the Event schema snippet. quick draft: ```{\n  "@context": "https://schema.org",\n  "@type": "Event",\n  "name": "Redwood Inference: Inference Cost & Latency Benchmark",\n  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00Z",\n  "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/inference-benchmark"\n}``` — will add location/offers once Jordan finalizes registration link.
Jordan Lee: added FAQ Qs in the doc under a \"SEO extras\" heading. some answers reference the benchmark report — might need a short excerpt for canonical.
Priya Rao: SDR routing — once form slug confirmed, map utm_source=webinar -> SDR-bucket-3. Also, make sure the webhook retries on 5xx. Ops will need the final routing table before launch.
Leo Chen: redirect PR opened: https://go.redwood/dev/redirects/PR-542. left a comment about the 302 -> 301 switch. need final paths by morning to avoid release holdup.
DeployBot: scheduled: docs deploy to staging 2026-04-10T08:00Z; will run schema validator and report back.
Maya Patel: action items: Samir finalize schema + keywords, Jordan finalize OG + H1, Priya confirm form slug + routing table, Leo finalize redirects PR. checkins tomorrow 10am. thanks everyone :rocket:
Samir Khan: noted. will ping once schema JSON-LD ready.
Jordan Lee: will update the draft and tag Maya when OG is ready.
Priya Rao: will confirm form slug by EOD and share webhook test payload.
Leo Chen: will get last paths in PR and set the 7-day 302 in conf.
Maya Patel: perfect — see you on the 10am sync.
